observations: Photo 0: Silver double-cab pickup, front view, parked on gravel lot with red canopy tents and other vehicles in background, consistent with a US-style auction/dealer yard rather than a Nigerian compound.
Photo 1: Same silver pickup, front-3/4 view, black alloy wheels, dealer-style paper sticker visible on windshield.

Photo 2: Rear view of the same truck. Tailgate reads 'TACOMA' and a 'V6' badge is visible. Handwritten marker text on the rear window reads 'No Start 963' - this looks like an auction/condition-report annotation.
No TRD badge or TRD lettering is visible in any photo despite the seller's text claiming 'TRD'.
No moonroof is visible or confirmable from the angles shown.
No photo of odometer, engine bay, VIN plate, customs/duty certificate, or any document mentioned by the seller (receipt, warranty, duty paper).

claims.claim: 2024 Toyota Tacoma TRD 4x4 with V6 engine
claims.evidence: V6 badge visible in photo 2; 'TRD' lettering/badge not visible in any photo; model year not verifiable from photos
No interior/dash photo showing start button

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows handwritten 'No Start 963' on the rear window glass, directly contradicting the claim that it works perfectly
No document shown in any photo

risks.risk: Vehicle may not start/run at all, as suggested by the lot annotation
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and idling, plus a clear photo of the dash/odometer
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-running / parts vehicle, effectively unsellable at normal market price

risks.risk: TRD trim and model year claims cannot be confirmed from badges or VIN
risks.proof: Clear photo of VIN plate and TRD badge/door jamb sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as base trim, unconfirmed year

risks.risk: Duty/clearance status and import documents unverified, risk of undocumented or smuggled vehicle
risks.proof: Photo of customs duty certificate with matching VIN
risks.if_unproven: priced as undocumented, higher import/clearance risk

risks.risk: Photos appear to be from a foreign auction/dealer lot (US-style markings, 'No Start' auction annotation) rather than the actual vehicle in Abuja
risks.proof: Fresh photos of the truck at the seller's actual location in Abuja with today's date/newspaper
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified location and possible stock-photo misrepresentation

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running, showing dashboard and odometer
Clear photo of VIN plate and matching customs duty paper
Photo of TRD badge/trim sticker and moonroof from exterior/roof angle
Fresh photos taken at the seller's current location in Abuja (with a visible local landmark or recent dated paper)
response.reason: The seller claims the truck 'works perfectly' and is 'like new,' but photo 2 clearly shows a handwritten 'No Start' notation on the rear window, a direct contradiction from an auction/dealer condition tag; combined with foreign-lot staging and no supporting documents, this points to a misrepresented or scam listing rather than a straightforward priceable vehicle.
